parameter_alignment.reference: TimeGeoDiT from dit_timegeo_v_plan.json; excludes frozen Prithvi

inputs.hls: B,6,224,224 unclipped reflectance; no Prithvi features or weights
inputs.hls_valid: B,1,224,224 boolean full-resolution mask, NOT patch averages or attention mask
inputs.coarse: B,1,224,224 existing normalized upsampled coarse LST
inputs.noisy_target: B,1,224,224 noisy normalized fine-minus-coarse LST residual
inputs.condition_projection: concat normalized six HLS bands, coarse LST, full pixel mask -> Conv2d(8,896,kernel=16,stride=16)

hls_scaling.reason: preserve previous input affine scaling; no pretrained encoder

conditioning.geography: actual crop center latitude/longitude -> sphere xyz and sin/cos at pi*[1,2,4]
conditioning.injection: each generation block: independent adaLN projections for both streams; final temperature adaLN; no metadata injected in condition encoder

attention.position: same spatial 2D RoPE coordinates on both streams Q/K; per-head QK RMSNorm
attention.mask: no causal or cloud attention mask
attention.generation: 5 full bidirectional joint blocks + final joint readout block
attention.final_block: condition K/V and 2-vector modulation only; unused condition Q/output/FFN/gates omitted
attention.cache: encoder output may be cached per sample; every NFE resets condition stream to that output

output.head: Linear(896,256), unpatchify
output.objective: existing VP v-prediction of normalized temperature residual
output.gradient_auxiliary: not added in this baseline; preserves existing v-only objective

data.members: reuse frozen HLC split members and metadata audit
data.normalization: reuse center-crop training-only LST/residual stats; check_stats required
data.fingerprint: new raw_hls_input entry plus inherited data, split, metadata hashes

validation.local_tests: 8 passed: parameter budget, full mask geometry, invalid input handling, autograd with/without checkpointing, cached/uncached equivalence, batch isolation, v-target/DDIM compatibility, full-size forward, cold-start optimizer updates
validation.hardware_scope: CPU only; full-size forward B=1; backward/optimizer tests use tiny architecture

launch.note: Architecture preparation only. A future run needs its own confirmed budget/run ID, full epoch validation, checkpoint retention and GPU preflight.
